description: PL-RELC PA decision under decision 114; CONTRACT.md section 6. Input recipe for REL-T/B/I. Exact Rust distribution approved here; unknown native pins block qualification and are never inferred from cross-builds.
component_version_policy: These are Rust distribution component versions, not clippy/rustfmt own version banners. Record full observed banners in native-inputs evidence. Cargo 1.97.1 is the approved distribution Cargo; a mismatch refuses.

linux-x64.reason: Exact runner image, kernel, glibc floor, compiler/linker pins and native profile evidence not supplied.

macos-arm64.reason: Observed macOS 26.6.2 (25G83) is not an approved SDK/linker/minimum-OS pin; exact native closure and profile evidence not supplied.

macos-x64.reason: Outside initial promotion set; native Intel Mac runner/tool pins and qualification evidence absent.

linux-arm64.reason: Outside initial promotion set; native aarch64 runner/tool pins and qualification evidence absent.

windows-x64.reason: Outside initial promotion set; native MSVC/SDK/runner pins and qualification evidence absent.

unknown_target.reason: Not in closed manifest target set; includes musl and other CPU/ABI triples. Unspecified OS/libc floors also block promotion.

SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.value: Exact source revision Unix UTC commit seconds from supplied source metadata; no runtime git or wall-clock fallback.

remap_path_prefix.policy: Map each actual absolute prefix, longest first; preserve required Cargo flags. Refuse unmapped absolute paths.

reproducibility.ordering: ASCII-escaped UTF-8 JSON sorted keys, compact separators, LF termination; no floats/duplicate keys. Sort set-like arrays by identity; SHA256SUMS by filename.
reproducibility.comparison: Two clean independent absolute build paths, same target/profile and exact approved inputs; compare every unsigned payload, manifest, checksums, SBOM, provenance and optional bundle byte-for-byte.
excluded: native observations and acceptance receipts; deterministic native input inventory remains in materials
